name: edit-list-marker-restyles
request: Change the priority text to '1. Migrate the queue'.
command: gdoc edit --tab '{TAB}' --account {A} {DOC} '2. Migrate the queue' '1. Migrate the queue'
expected: Paragraph reads `Priority: 1. Migrate the queue`, still a plain paragraph (no list), `Priority:` still bold.
explain: The first paragraph is 'Priority: 2. Migrate the queue', with 'Priority:' in bold. We asked gdoc to change the '2.' to '1.'. Because the new text begins with '1.', gdoc treated it like the start of a numbered list and turned the whole paragraph into a list item, and the bold on 'Priority:' is gone. Look at the first paragraph in the after tab: it now has a list number in front of it and no bold.
